values.note: Power-only pull-through sites (1-6) C$43 a night, 20-amp C$45, 30-amp C$46, oversized sites (43-58) C$52, tent sites C$30, all plus GST. A camper pulling a trailer or a motorhome towing a trailer may be charged up to double the site fee (vehicle carriers free). C$20 refundable deposit for the washroom key.

fees.source: Fort Lions Campground site https://www.fortlionscampground.com/ (Squarespace collection updated 2026-04-30; read 2026-11-11): 'Sites 1 - 6: Power only $43 + GST', 'Sites 25, 26, 27: Tents $30 + GST', 'Sites 7 - 42: 20 amp $45 + GST', 'Sites 7 - 42: 30 amp $46 + GST', 'Sites 43 - 58: Oversized $52 + GST'; 'Any form of multiple RV units such as Campers pulling RV trailers or Motorhomes pulling trailers will be charged an extra daily fee up to double the cost of their site. No charge for vehicle carriers.'; '$20 deposit for bathroom access key and fully refundable upon return'

values.note: Reserve by phone or email. The cancellation fee is one night. Sites assigned at booking may be changed by the manager. Check-out 11 am.

booking.source: Fort Lions Campground site https://www.fortlionscampground.com/ (Squarespace collection updated 2026-04-30; read 2026-11-11): 'For information or reservations, please call 780-998-4074 or e-mail'; 'Cancellation fee is 1 night's stay'; 'Sites assigned at time of reservation may be changed at the discretion of the Campground manager.'; 'Checkout time is 11:00 AM'

note: Fort Saskatchewan Lions Club campground in Turner Park, in the city's river valley just below the historic downtown, with the city trail system at the gate. Open fires are not allowed; propane fire pits can be rented. --Claude
summary: Operator site (updated April 2026): base C$43 + GST power-only pull-through (to C$52 oversized), 20/30/50-amp sites with water and sewer, phone/email booking, showers. electric 30 -> 50. DROP CANDIDATE: Google 3.7 from 131 reviews (Lions-club precedent). WATERFRONT: riverview -> not waterfront recommended. Season not stated.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (reviews, same as the earlier Lions-club drops): Google Maps 3.7 from 131 reviews ('Located in: Turner Park', phone +1 780-998-4074, website fortlionscampground.com). RV Life 4* over 7 (inclusion_evidence, not re-read).
PRICE GATE: base C$43 + GST (sites 1-6, power-only pull-throughs); passes C$69. Gateway: Elk Island NP 26 km, Edmonton 27 km (not needed).
OWNERSHIP: local kept (Fort Saskatchewan Lions Club, 'managed by very friendly accommodating contractors'; service-club convention). Google places it in the city's Turner Park.
PHONE / WEBSITE: stored 780-998-4074 matches the site and Google; fortlionscampground.com answered 200 and is this campground.

WATERFRONT (recommend riverview -> not waterfront): on Esri imagery (0.67 m/px) the westernmost sites are ~45-50 m from the North Saskatchewan's water across the gravel River Road/trail and a ~15-20 m wooded riverbank strip - not open ground, so not riverfront, and no source says the river can be seen from a site (the operator: 'located in Fort Saskatchewan's beautiful river valley'; a Google review: 'close access to walking trails, open fields, play grounds and the river'). Unsure after every source, so downgrade. Also seen: wooded backwater ponds among the NE sites (standing water in trees on the imagery); not a lake or river frontage.
SEASON: not stated on the operator site; nothing written.
SITES: numbered 1-58 (3 of them tent sites); no total stated, so no count written.
PIN (53.7195,-113.2124): on the west row of sites beside River Road; Google 53.71961,-113.21220 - OK.
NOTE: 'beside the North Saskatchewan River' and the tent rate dropped (rate now in fees.note; waterfront gate not met).
